name: unity-2d-3d-building
description: Build, wire and ship a Unity game as an agent: install the engine, create a project from a template, drive the editor through Unity's own CLI bridge or a free MCP server, source licence-cleared CC0 assets online, and build to WebGL that you verify in a browser. Carries the Battle TV painted-broadcast style as a worked reference and a living art log.

network.note: No code in this package fetches anything. The guide names CC0 asset hosts for the user's own agent to fetch from, under the licence gate in references/assets-and-licences.md.

filesystem.write: append references/techniques.md only, after a watched build confirms a method
